messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: Trouble Getting R to Start
parts:
What is your operating system? Usually, no configuration is required. On Windows, Nvim-R looks for R in the Windows registry. On Unix (Linux, Mac OS X, and others) R usually is in the path. If \ is your LocalLeader, you have to press \rf in Normal mode (not in Insert mode).

To test if Nvim-R is correctly installed and the file type was recognized as R, in Insert mode, press _ (underline). It should turn into <-
